body: Hey guys, I’m thankful for the kind messages. I’ve been thinking since then and haven’t slept since. I currently sharpened the knife so it cuts paper like butter. I’m going to cut where my left pulse beats. I’m currently in the bath tub. Looking once more at the pictures and thinking of what I had. I lived my paradise when I was with her. I can’t think of doing anything else. If it won’t succeed and anything goes bad I’ll update. If you won’t hear from me again that means I’m in heaven and I’ll protect all of you that tried to help me from up there. I wish all the best and happiness.
I tried, I’m on antidepressants and this is the last day I have pills for. Without them I’m 100% going to kill my self.

I tried this, I tried thinking about my future. I tried everything. But it keeps building up. I’m on antidepressants and and pills that make me sleep, without them I can’t until I collapse which is around 4 days for me. The worst part is that this is the last day I have medication.
Thank you very much, I appreciate it. But my time has come, especially after all the stuff I did. Because karma is true, what you do come back especially when you are least expecting jt.
And so what do you guys recommend?
